0022600211.text: The New York Knicks (5-4, 3-2 at home, on a three-game winning streak) host the Milwaukee Bucks (1-9, 1-5 on the road, on a six-game losing streak) in the Knicks' 10th game of the 2026-27 season. The teams have not met yet this season, and New York won the 2025-26 series 2-1, including a 127-98 win in Milwaukee on February 27, 2026. Josh Hart is out for New York with an illness, while Milwaukee's Kel'el Ware (ankle sprain) and Tyler Herro (knee bruise) are both listed as day-to-day and are game-time decisions.
